run_selfplay_console: run the DarkForest selfplay console with an evaluator and model interface in selfplay mode
create_evaluator: create an Evaluator instance with stats disabled for selfplay evaluation
load_environment: load the environment with selfplay mode overrides using load_env from rlpytorch
setup_model_interface: setup a ModelInterface with model and actor instances and set them to eval mode
register_actor_callback: register a custom actor callback function to the game controller for batch tracking
